3 . From what is known about nutrition and the impact that it has on the musculoskeletal system, which of the 
following foods would you expect the nurse to include in dietary teaching for the client? 
a. Leafy green vegetables 
b. Dairy products 
c. Red meat 
d. Protein shakes 
4 . After the nurse finishes the instructions, which of the following statements by the client indicates additional 
education is needed? 
a. “I will try to incorporate more berries into my diet.” 
b. “I will stop eating nuts.” 
c. “I will try to eat more salmon and tuna.” 
d. “I will eat fewer carbohydrates.”
